what_happened: Confirmed via code tracing + git history that the redeploy-checkpoint/command-gate-out.sh baseline comparison is already identity-based (comm -13 set diff since 2026-10-03, not count-based); the real escape is that any source-store-resident defect (committed in an earlier cycle) is always classified 'temporally pre-existing' within the checkpoint's own narrow pre/post window, so the existing attribution filter (which only applies to the 'candidate new' branch) never sees it.

Research report pre-refuted one of the dispatch's own two headline hypotheses (count-based vs identity-based baseline comparison), which removed a whole candidate change from the plan instead of adding one. Planning also re-derived both of the report's load-bearing empirical claims (zero provides.scripts curation exceptions across all 9 extensions with a scripts/ tree; two non-jq-canonical manifests) in two commands, so no figure was carried unverified.

test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh fails 1/15 (baseline fixture is not clean, gate20 finding lines=0) identically with and without the Phase 2 deploy-baseline-lib.sh refactor (verified via git stash push/pop on the lib file alone) -- confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this task; not touched further.

run-all.sh --jobs auto reported test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh as a NEW failure, but it is unrelated to this task (lints lint-state-writer-boundary.sh, a script this task never touches) and passes 8/8 when re-run standalone immediately afterward -- a load-sensitive flake under the parallel run, not a regression. test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's 1/15 failure was already confirmed pre-existing and unrelated in Phase 2 (identical with/without this task's deploy-baseline-lib.sh refactor). Also found and fixed: test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh was missing its executable bit after being created via the Write tool (chmod +x applied); test-dispatch-metrics.sh, test-lint-agent-contracts-heartbeat.sh, test-script-inventory.sh, test-task-lock-liveness.sh are also non-executable but pre-date this task (Oct 2-3) and are untouched by it.
